conf.description: Infoblox NIOS DDI - DNS Firewall / RPZ hit, syslog-cef format. Branches the shared named stream on the RPZ-* device event class (not just the generic CEF:0|Infoblox|NIOS| prefix, which the dns-query dataset also uses), parses the nested rewrite/via msg grammar, and fixes the two documented defects in the stock integration's own RPZ branch.

conf.comment: infoblox-ddi / dns-firewall-rpz / syslog-cef. Deliberately NOT routed through the stock infoblox_nios integration's existing RPZ branch: (1) it writes RPZ-<TYPE> to dns.answers.type, a question-side rule identifier in an answer-side field - kept custom here instead (infoblox.nios.rpz.rule_type); (2) its msg dissect requires a trailing CAT= that locally-authored RPZ rules and older NIOS builds omit, dropping every rpz.* subfield - CAT is optional here. event.severity keeps the CEF numeric 8/7/6/4 scale (ECS wants a long); the NIOS critical/major/warning/informational label is added as infoblox.nios.rpz.severity_label alongside it, not overwriting the number. event.outcome uses allowed/blocked (access-control semantics), not success/failure: PASSTHRU is an allow-list hit, every other action is a block/redirect. The msg rewrite/via grammar was reconstructed from field-table prose, not a raw sample - see README gap.

functions.description: why this pipeline exists, scope, and the fixes over the stock integration's RPZ branch
coarse guard: only CEF:0|Infoblox|NIOS| lines from the shared named stream continue
split the syslog header (timestamp, grid member, tag) from the CEF payload
split the 7 pipe-delimited CEF header fields (device event class, name/action, severity) from the extension blob
fine guard: only RPZ-* device event classes are the RPZ hit dataset - a plain DNS query/response CEF line shares the same CEF:0|Infoblox|NIOS| prefix and must not reach this pipeline's mapping
explode the space-separated key=value CEF extensions (src, spt, dst, app, view, qtype, and a first pass at msg which the next step corrects)
capture the msg value without swallowing an optional trailing CAT= extension (CAT is absent on locally-authored RPZ rules and older NIOS builds)

conf.code: var raw = String(__e['msg_raw']||''); var m = /^rewrite\s+(\S+)\s+via\s+(\S+)(?:\s+\[(\S+)\])?(?:\s+([\s\S]*))?$/.exec(raw); if (m){   var qname = m[1].replace(/\.$/,'').toLowerCase();   var rpzRecord = m[2];   __e['dns'] = __e['dns'] || {}; __e['dns']['question'] = __e['dns']['question'] || {};   __e['dns']['question']['name'] = qname;   __e['rule'] = __e['rule'] || {};   __e['rule']['name'] = rpzRecord;   var prefix = qname + '.';   if (rpzRecord.indexOf(prefix) === 0){ __e['rule']['ruleset'] = rpzRecord.substring(prefix.length); }   if (m[3]){ __e['infoblox'] = __e['infoblox'] || {}; __e['infoblox']['nios'] = __e['infoblox']['nios'] || {}; __e['infoblox']['nios']['rpz'] = __e['infoblox']['nios']['rpz'] || {}; __e['infoblox']['nios']['rpz']['query_class_rewrite'] = m[3]; }   if (m[4]){ __e['event'] = __e['event'] || {}; __e['event']['reason'] = m[4]; } }

functions.description: parse the nested 'rewrite <QNAME> via <RPZ_RECORD> [<type>] <error>' grammar inside msg into dns.question.name, rule.name, rule.ruleset (derived by stripping the queried name off the trigger record), the bracketed rewrite type, and event.reason

derived fields read from ORIGINAL vendor/regex-capture names (observer.*, process.name, message, event.action/outcome, event.severity + severity_label, rule_type, rule.category, event.dataset), then drop pipeline-internal scratch fields and superseded originals
batch rename every status:mapped 1:1 CEF extension field to its ECS target
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
